title: Senior AI/LLM Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems into production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Designs and deploys AI agents and multi-agent solutions in LangGraph that work with tools, APIs and databases, along with RAG architectures built on embeddings and vector databases. Sets up evaluation, tracing and monitoring for production AI on healthcare data, and fine-tunes models where retrieval needs it. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Policy Question Answering Agent
bullets: Built a multi-agent assistant in LangGraph that answers employee questions on banking policies and procedures, combining RAG over a vector database with tool calls to internal APIs and databases.
Evaluated it with LLM evaluators for faithfulness and citation accuracy plus agent tracing, then served it through FastAPI on Azure with monitoring and guardrails for regulated use.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior AI/LLM Data Scientist role in Agentic AI. As a Senior Data Scientist at United Health Group, I build LLM agents, multi-agent systems and RAG pipelines and run them in production with evaluation and monitoring. The thread through my work is making these systems reliable enough that a business can depend on them.

ING is putting agentic AI into banking, where every answer has to be traceable and correct, and that is the standard I already work to with healthcare data. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Amsterdam together and settle there long term.

I built a multi-agent analytics chatbot in LangGraph that calls PySpark tools and cut manual analysis by 98%, and evaluation pipelines with LLM evaluators and tracing that reduced human review by 43%. At Viavi my RAG assistant reached a 90% match rate. I would bring those patterns, and the habit of sharing them, to your teams.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building for teachers and children has taught me to be careful about what an AI system says and who relies on it. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
